notes.title: Patch Notes - Demo Week 2
notes.notes:

notes.title: Steam Deck & Controller Support
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p]This is my first post here on the community page, and I wanted to share a look into the core design of [i]Vital Shell[/i].[/p][p]A huge inspiration for the game is my love for 90s console classics like [i]Armored Core[/i] and [i]Frame Gride[/i]. It only made sense to develop [i]Vital Shell[/i] with a [b]console-first approach[/b] from day one. This means all of the UI is clean, flat, and hierarchy-based, so it feels incredible to navigate whether you're on a big screen with a controller or on your Steam Deck.  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645674/984702e8f2b2133154cf729befa39a340cb103b9.gif"][/img] [/p][p]Thanks to Godot's focus engine and these design principles, the game worked great with a controller almost out of the box. I've since put in the work to refine the experience, improving modal presentation and ensuring the UI always remembers your last selection when moving between pages. I'm happy to say it's all sorted, and at this point, navigating the menus and playing the game truly feels best with a controller.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645674/d52ce98acd2b260828cac76b86af2e966ccc23ca.gif"][/img] [/p][p]It’s not just the menus—combat feels just as smooth. Actions are kept on the triggers to keep your thumbs freed up to stay on the sticks![/p][list][*][p][b]Movement:[/b] D-pad or Left Stick[/p][/*][*][p][b]Manual Aiming:[/b] Right Stick[/p][/*][*][p][b]Special Ability:[/b] R2 (or equivalent)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Boost: [/b]L2 (or equivalent)[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45645674/c01ea9b8ff1b898dff96583703daeec149b7f0d2.gif"][/img]
I'm working hard to get a closed beta ready, which will lead to a polished demo this summer. The best way to stay in the loop is to [b]Wishlist & Follow[/b] the game![/p][p]Stay tuned![/p]
